rca_summary: SAP application connection refused due to the SAP connection listener being stopped or unavailable on the affected worker node.
step_guidance: Verify the incident report to confirm connection refused signals and ensure preconditions are met by checking that the SAP connection listener is down on the affected worker node.
Run diagnostics using DiagnosticAgent to isolate the stopped listener process.
Execute restart_listener via ConnectivityAgent to bring the SAP connection listener back online.
Run validation checks using ValidationAgent to ensure the listener is active and that the connection probe succeeds before resolving the incident.
After failed restart validation, use one approved listener recovery and repeat the health probe
validation_steps: listener is up and connection probe succeeds

rca_summary: Oracle archive destination capacity exhausted, resulting in blocked database write operations across affected nodes.
step_guidance: Execute diagnose using DiagnosticAgent to confirm archive storage exhaustion and ensure valid backups exist prior to cleanup.
Obtain required approval and initiate archive_cleanup via StorageAgent to reclaim archive storage capacity.
Execute validate using ValidationAgent to ensure archive capacity is restored and database write probes succeed.
preconditions: archive capacity exhausted; demo backup verified
validation_steps: archive has capacity and database write probe succeeds

rca_summary: SAP service accounts become locked following failed authentication attempts and rejected logins on worker nodes.
step_guidance: Confirm that the SAP service account is locked and identity verification prerequisites are met.
Perform diagnostic checks using DiagnosticAgent to investigate authentication failure logs on the affected worker node.
Obtain required approval and execute the unlock_account action via IdentityAgent to restore account access.
Execute validation using ValidationAgent to ensure the account is unlocked and authentication probes succeed before closing the incident.
preconditions: account is locked; demo identity verified
validation_steps: account is unlocked and authentication probe succeeds

rca_summary: Oracle scheduled batch job failures are caused by transient worker unavailability across worker nodes.
step_guidance: Diagnose the failure using DiagnosticAgent to verify that the batch job failure was due to transient worker unavailability and confirm the worker node is accessible.
Verify preconditions ensuring the job remains incomplete and the retry operation is idempotent.
Trigger retry_job with JobAgent to re-run the failed batch job.
Use ValidationAgent to confirm that the job completed successfully and the expected output exists.
preconditions: job incomplete; demo operation is idempotent
validation_steps: job completed and expected output exists
